aiReviewer: OpenAI GPT-6 (AI editorial review, not independent human review)
reviewNotes: Reviewed 32 original B1/B2 preposition questions for 16 seeds. For every exercise solved without key, evaluated all four choices against natural German, semantic relationship and surrounding case; checked answers, completed text, hints and bilingual explanation. No changed source material or existing objectives. Very similar prepositional expressions are not presented as competing choices where both would work. Category reflects lexical choice, not prior grammatical objectives. Not CEFR-certified or measured learner performance; structural validation via repository CI, no independent publication approval.

rows.notes: Reviewed all eight options across two original questions for German usage, meaning and cases; checked both full sentences, answer links, hints, explanations and distinct contexts. Retained source level B2 provisionally.
rows.corrections: The source examples and approval flags were not relied on; newly written contexts isolate the intended semantic relationship.
rows.rightsBasis: Only basic lexical and grammatical properties of the seed are used; original sentences, distractors and explanations. No external examples copied; rights and publication review remain pending.
